properties.name: The build's gate list becomes runnable, and the sweep harness is registered rather than deleted
properties.rationale: THE CONTRACT WAS CHECKED AND NEVER RUN. Three records of the gate list existed — ci.yml runs it, AGENTS.md lists it for a person, skill_lint fails the build when those two disagree on coverage or flags — and no artifact executed it. So a local pass had to be reconstructed from memory, and three sessions produced three different subsets: a split cargo run 46 tests short, a subset that missed the gate which would have caught the defect, and on 2026-09-20 a script running 17 of 48 with cargo test piped through head -40, which truncates the report at the fortieth of roughly two hundred test binaries and can kill the run through the closed pipe. Forty consecutive passes reads exactly like a clean sweep. THE RUNNER READS THE LIST RATHER THAN RESTATING IT, and that is the whole design: a fourth hand-kept copy would be the drift it exists to end, so it imports the parser the build already trusts instead of writing a second one — the same second-builder mistake chg:a-reply-carries-its-payload-once-on-every-tool was fixing one file over, which is why it was not made again here. It stays standard-library-only because pyyaml is not in the base image, which is exactly why skill_lint's parser is a text scan. ITS OWN FIRST DRAFT HAD THE FAILURE IT EXISTS TO END, twice: it printed a clean summary on a filter matching nothing, and it never returned a non-zero exit code at all, so that day's sweeps were read off the log by eye. Both are now refusals and both are pinned. The net's own first run then failed on a test that was wrong rather than on the runner, and that is recorded on the Verification rather than quietly corrected.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: tools/run_ci_gates.py runs every gate ci.yml defines, in its order, reading the list through skill_lint's ci_gates() rather than restating it. tools/test_run_ci_gates.py is its hermetic net and is registered as a CI gate in both ci.yml and AGENTS.md's block. AGENTS.md gains a paragraph above that block pointing at the runner and saying why hand-writing one is the thing to stop. SEPARATELY AND ON THE SAME WORD: tools/sweep_harness.py is registered as an Artifact instead of being deleted. It was committed by accident in PR #551 through a `git add -A tools` glob, and a session that had not opened the file recommended removing it as scratch. It is the instrument behind fact:179-of-180-tools-have-a-machine-record-of-a-real-call-and-zero-crashed, which answered Anthony's question of 2026-09-11, so deleting it would have made a cited measurement unreproducible. The earlier recommendation was withdrawn on 2026-09-20 after reading the file.
